Copy data from a CFVariable to a geozarr_array

Source: R/aggregate.R
copy_to_geozarr.Rd

This function will take a CFVariable and copy the data into a GeoZarr array in a Zarr store.

Usage

copy_to_geozarr(var, geozarr, verbose = FALSE)

Arguments

var

A CFVariable instance to copy the data from.

geozarr

A geozarr_array instance to copy data to.

verbose

Logical. If TRUE, the progress of copying is printed to the console, per chunk of the geozarr_array that is written. Default is FALSE.

Value

var, invisibly.

Details

The GeoZarr array must have been initialised before calling this function. The create_geozarr_array() can be used for that purpose.

Missing data in the CFVariable are translated to the GeoZarr conventions, see the "Exporting data" vignette for details.

A scalar axis of the CFVariable can be an axis of the GeoZarr array, with a length of 1 for the variable. This is how variables from multiple files, each with its own scalar axis value such as an ensemble member or a height, are combined along a new dimension.

The CFVariable axes have to be compatible with those of the GeoZarr array. Specifically, the values of the (active) coordinates of each axis have to be a contiguous subset of the corresponding axis (by position) of the GeoZarr array.
